blurb: The Club at Boca Pointe features a private 18-hole championship golf course, 13 Har-Tru tennis courts, 4 pickleball courts, 4 padel courts, and a 28,000 square foot Sports Center with a cafe, fitness equipment, personal training, group exercise, and aquatics. The 80,000 square foot clubhouse includes restaurants, bars, and a renovated event space for social activities. Membership provides access to these facilities and social events year-round or seasonally.
